facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely: EU banks commonly offer foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Get a trade licence (živnostenský list) for CZK 1,000 and become an OSVČ.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your personal identification number, until you register for VAT.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 15%, and 23% above about CZK 1.76 million.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 21% VAT once turnover in Czechia exceeds CZK 2 million a year.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Flat-rate regime: one monthly payment covers income tax and insurance, up to CZK 2m.

watch_out.text: Passing CZK 2,536,500 makes you a VAT payer the very next day.
